content_clarity_corrections.corrected_explanation: In complete dominance, the dominant allele determines the heterozygote's phenotype, while the recessive allele is masked. content_clarity_corrections.reason: The original stem could be read too broadly because codominance and incomplete dominance are also heterozygous inheritance patterns; the previous distractors were weak and non-parallel. content_clarity_corrections.reason: The original stem was broad because gibberellins can also promote stem elongation, while its animal-hormone distractors were implausibly easy.
